newsitem.title: UK: Williams up on press recommendation. [CORRECTED 14:24 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Williams up on press recommendation. [CORRECTED 14:24 GMT]

text.p: Shares in Britain's Williams Holdings Plc rose on Monday after a "buy" recommendation in the Sunday Times newspaper, which said most analysts thought the company deserved a premium rating.
Bt 1157 GMT shares in the fire protection and security products group were up 6p at 345p.

Following its 360 (corrects from 303) million stg building products disposal last week, the paper said the company was studying new additions to its core businesses which "could yield significantly higher returns."
